items.Sentence: The new septic tanks at the Historic Comfort Center and the Ranger office will have capacities of 15,000 gallons and 2,000 gallons, respectively. The septic tank for the new Visitor Contact Center will have a 55,000 gallon capacity.
New 6-inch PVC pipe will convey effluent from all three new septic tanks to a 20,000 gallon dosing tank for flow equalization.

The effluent will be discharged from the dosing tank into a new 3-acre leachfield southwest of the South Entrance Station along an existing service road that is to be improved to provide all year access.

The proposed leachfield will cover about 3.0 acres and will consist of a pressure distribution leach trench constructed in four cells. Each cell is equipped with its own 6-outlet automatic, SCADA monitored distributing valve, and each cell consists of six zones typically with two 120-foot laterals.
Each leachfield cell will have an inspection port in each leachfield lateral for monitoring wastewater depth in the leach trenches.
Two groundwater monitoring wells will be installed at the base of the leachfield to measure the depth to water below the leachfield area.
